content: The CCB also found that the mobile phone used for uploading the video was purchased in Karol Bagh, Delhi, specifically for the alleged operation

content: The party seeks strict action against officials found negligent and those responsible for the violence

content: Karnataka Swimming Association calls for a Swimming Pools Act to ensure safety norms and quality guidelines

title: Avarekai cultivation in Kolar district drops by 70% amid rainfall deficit
content: The decline is attributed to inadequate rainfall, depleting groundwater levels and dry weather conditions, which have discouraged farmers from taking up sowing

title: Andhra school chainsaw attack: Accused shot in encounter while attempting to flee
content: A heinous attack unfolded at Raptadu Government High School when Hemanth assaulted Gopika, a Class 10 student, with a saw. The quick response from the police resulted in his arrest on charges of attempted murder. While being transported, he made an escape attempt, prompting police to fire. Hemanth was injured and taken to Anantapur Government General Hospital, where security is heightened to ensure the situation remains controlled.

title: US daylight saving time 2026 ends; clocks fall back 1 hour, sleep experts object
content: Daylight saving time concluded on November 1, resulting in darker evenings and an extra hour of sleep. The debate continues over making daylight saving time a permanent fixture instead of switching twice yearly. Recent legislation has stalled in the Senate despite bipartisan support from the House. Public opinion favors maintaining standard time over permanent daylight saving time due to sleep cycle considerations.

title: US midterms: Trump ready with plan to outmaneuver Democrat-controlled Congress
content: Senior aides, including deputy chief of staff Stephen Miller and budget director Russell Vought, have been working with the White House Counsel's Office since April to identify measures Trump could pursue without congressional approval. These include policies on immigration, tariffs, housing costs and federal spending, according to a White House official and two people familiar with the plans.

title: Pippa Middleton ordered to demolish car park at £15.5m estate
content: Pippa Middleton, Princess Catherine’s sister, and her husband James Matthews have been ordered to demolish an unauthorised car park at their £15.5 million Barton Court estate. West Berkshire Council ruled against the development after local residents objected to construction without consultation, citing concerns over its impact on the rural character of Kintbury.

title: Harmanpreet's hat-trick sinks Malaysia as India keep perfect ACT unbeaten record
content: In a thrilling Asian Champions Trophy match, India triumphed over Malaysia with a score of 4-2. Harmanpreet Singh mesmerized fans by netting a spectacular hat-trick, while Sukhjeet Singh added to the excitement with a brilliant field goal. Although Malaysia briefly leveled the score, they couldn't maintain their momentum. This victory leaves India unbeaten as they gear up for their next challenge against South Korea.

title: 'Monkey still on my back': Tim Seifert rues missed century, hails Glenn Phillips
content: Tim Seifert delivered an impressive performance with 93 runs in the final T20I against India, narrowly missing his first international century. New Zealand triumphed with a seven-wicket win, albeit losing the series 2-3 overall. Seifert credited the team’s growth and adaptive strategies, while Glenn Phillips shone brightly, setting a new record for runs in a bilateral T20I series. Seifert lauded Phillips for his pivotal role in the team's batting success.

title: Delaware couple wins land dispute after neighbours demand $30,000
content: After two decades of contention, a Delaware court officially awarded Joseph W.C. Murray, Jr. and Danielle F. Murray ownership of a long-disputed parcel of land. The case arose when the Preradovic family challenged property lines after purchasing an adjacent lot. Failed negotiations led to litigation, ultimately resulting in the court granting the Murrays the rear yard while their claims to the front areas were rejected.

title: Once homeless, billionaire backs project growing 8m pounds of produce
content: John Paul DeJoria overcame homelessness not once, but twice, before establishing thriving ventures in the hair-care and spirits sectors. A dedicated philanthropist, he signed the Giving Pledge to relinquish a minimum of half his fortune. Through the JP’s Peace, Love & Happiness Foundation, he champions diverse initiatives, especially food security. Notably, the Grow Appalachia program has empowered countless families to cultivate their own food.

title: US senators write to Google CEO Sundar Pichai with 9 questions on classroom AI push
content: Two US senators have requested answers from Google CEO Sundar Pichai about the effects of AI tools on children. They highlighted concerns regarding the integration of AI products in schools and their potential negative impacts. The senators have set a deadline for a response by November 2, 2026. They specifically seek information on research conducted about AI's impact on children’s mental health.

title: Florence Pugh's childhood Oxfordshire home listed for £1.65m
content: Florence Pugh's parents, Clinton Pugh and Deborah Mackin, have listed their Grade II-listed Oxfordshire barn for £1.65 million. The Oppenheimer actress grew up in the 17th-century property, which her parents purchased for £950,000 in 2011. The couple are reportedly considering downsizing as their children have gradually moved out of the family home.

title: China's mysterious submarine could give US Navy a Pacific nightmare
content: China is currently testing an innovative uncrewed trimaran submarine that boasts an arsenal of missiles, designed to significantly strengthen its military presence against US naval forces in the Indo-Pacific. This submarine could possess between 16 and 18 of China's cutting-edge YJ-20 hypersonic anti-ship missiles. Its tactics may feature submerging before launching surprise missile strikes on enemy ships, presenting serious implications for US Navy strategic operations.

title: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio estate faces new security concerns
content: Travis Kelce's $5.35 million Ohio mansion is facing fresh neighborhood tensions as residents challenge proposed property changes over concerns about lake views, tree height and a century-old shared sewer line. The dispute comes weeks after reports revealed that Kelce and Taylor Swift installed an audible security system to discourage trespassers. The village's architectural review board has delayed its decision and plans to revisit the revised proposal on November 10.

title: Delhi's anti-pollution curbs: Monster jam at Sirhaul border; commuters stuck for hrs
content: Heavy traffic congestion affected thousands of commuters attempting to travel from Gurgaon to Delhi on Sunday. This situation was caused by increased police checks at the Sirhaul border targeting compliance with vehicle restrictions. Multiple barricades were installed, which exacerbated the already difficult traffic conditions for vehicles of all types. Rahul Gandhi's rally in Delhi further complicated the congestion, with buses carrying supporters caught in the jam.

title: Can children’s social media access be restricted? What the law says
content: Recent Supreme Court proceedings emphasize the need for safeguards when children access the internet and social media. The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, effective from May 2027, mandates parental consent for children's data. States like Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh propose age-based restrictions for social media access. Parents are encouraged to seek support from platforms in case of online harm.

title: Rahul's Ramlila 'jalsa' to 'rub salt in wounds' of 1984 Sikh riot victims: Amit Shah
content: Union home minister Amit Shah said the "jalsa" would reopen painful memories for the victims and their families, accusing the Congress of showing little sensitivity towards the tragedy. Shah made the remarks in Chandigarh while addressing a gathering after inaugurating and laying the foundation stones for development projects worth Rs 258 crore.

title: PV Sindhu wins second title of 2026, keeps BWF World Tour Finals hopes alive
content: PV Sindhu triumphed at the Hylo Open Super 500 in Germany, overpowering Line Hojmark Kjærsfeldt in an impressive straight-set victory. With scores of 21-12 and 21-14, this win not only marks her second title this season but also earned her 9,200 points for the ranking. Her journey included reaching the French Open final, showcasing her remarkable athletic prowess and enhancing her chances for the upcoming BWF World Tour Finals.

title: 'Gyanesh, when will you vanish?' Mamata mocks CEC - who said what at INDIA bloc rally
content: During a rally at Ramlila Maidan on Sunday, senior leaders from the INDIA coalition raised alarms about electoral roll manipulation. They accused the BJP of endangering democracy through the Chief Election Commissioner. Opposition leaders like Rahul Gandhi and Mamata Banerjee demanded Gyanesh Kumar's removal and vowed to continue their campaign against him.

title: Violent protests rock Bangladesh garment hubs as workers demand pay hike
content: The unrest, which began on Saturday, escalated on Sunday in industrial areas such as Mirpur in Dhaka and Konabari in Gazipur. Protesters allegedly vandalised factories, attacked police outposts with stones and set police vehicles on fire. Several major roads were blocked using barricades, disrupting movement. Police used tear gas and sound grenades to disperse crowds as demonstrations intensified.

title: Dhak beats on the Thames! British Bengalis take Durga Puja to London's iconic river
content: British Bengalis marked the fifth annual Durga Parade on the River Thames in London this Saturday. The event featured a decorated idol of Goddess Durga sailing past famous landmarks like Big Ben and the London Eye. Musical performances and dancing were part of the celebrations aboard the boat, showcasing local talent. Bihar Tourism Minister Kedar Prasad Gupta attended and invited Indians to visit Bihar.

title: 'Built as a Team. Won as a Team': Gambhir's strong message after series win
content: After clinching the T20I series against New Zealand with a final score of 3-2, head coach Gautam Gambhir praised the collective effort of the team. Despite a setback in the last match, India's strong beginning had already ensured their series triumph. Ishan Kishan and Shreyas Iyer were pivotal in this encounter, exemplifying how the players effectively embraced high-pressure situations throughout the series.

title: India trying to bring Russia, Ukraine & Europe to the table on 3 fronts: Jaishankar
content: India's External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar has discussed the protection of civilian shipping with Russia, Ukraine, and European nations. Efforts are being made to restore grain exports through the Black Sea, which have significantly declined. Additionally, the safety of energy infrastructure and fuel shipments is a major concern amid the ongoing conflict. Different interpretations of energy infrastructure complicate discussions on protection measures.

title: Jharkhand: 16-year-old goes to meet boyfriend, 'gangraped' by driver, 2 others
content: A 16-year-old girl was gangraped in Palamu district, Jharkhand, while returning home in an e-rickshaw. She was returning after trying to meet her boyfriend, whose parents had arranged his marriage to someone else. The police arrested three suspects, aged 20 to 38 years, on October 31 based on the girl’s statement. They have been charged under the BNS and POCSO Act for their involvement in the incident.

title: 'Please listen now': Yousuf's blunt advice to Babar Azam amid batting slump
content: Mohammad Yousuf has urged Babar Azam to pursue specialised coaching in Australia or South Africa. Yousuf expressed concerns over Babar's current batting struggles during the recent tri-series final against Sri Lanka. Despite Pakistan's victory, Babar's lack of significant contributions has raised questions about his form. Calls for Babar to focus on improvement before the upcoming Test series have also been voiced.

title: 'There is no word like 'dar' in my dictionary': Gambhir after India win NZ series
content: Gautam Gambhir urged his players to remain unshaken by fears following their recent series triumph against New Zealand. The team had an impressive run with three wins but faltered in the final two games. Shreyas Iyer, the captain, called attention to necessary improvements in bowling and fielding skills. Despite setbacks and playing in challenging conditions, optimism persists among the team.

title: Arshdeep creates history in 5th T20I, equals Tim Southee's powerplay record
content: In an impressive display of skill, Arshdeep Singh equaled Tim Southee's record for the most powerplay wickets in T20Is, taking his 65th wicket during an exciting match against New Zealand, achieved in only 99 innings. His key wicket of Finn Allen was crucial for India, although New Zealand's Tim Seifert and Daryl Mitchell formed a vital partnership to stabilize their innings, emphasizing Arshdeep's growing impact in T20 cricket.

title: Glenn Phillips scripts history, breaks world record in stunning series vs India
content: Glenn Phillips made headlines by setting the record for the most runs in a bilateral T20I series, scoring 341 runs against India. His series was marked by an impressive century and three half-centuries, showcasing his talent. Despite New Zealand's overall loss of 2-3, the team’s last match saw Tim Seifert shine with a fantastic 93, boosting morale as they look to build on this progress.

title: 'We were a bit sloppy': Iyer points out India's mistakes after 5th T20I defeat
content: After the defeat to New Zealand, India’s captain Shreyas Iyer reflected on the team's performance, admitting flaws in batting, bowling, and fielding. Scoring 191 runs, the team struggled with key partnerships at pivotal moments. New Zealand triumphed due to significant contributions from Tim Seifert and Glenn Phillips. Iyer called for enhanced focus on fielding, especially in tough conditions, claiming that although the team lost, valuable lessons were still learned.

title: Another 'exploding pager' plot? Israel eyes strike on Tehran’s top military bosses
content: Israel is considering a covert operation similar to its previous attacks targeting Iran's military leadership. Former Mossad official Oded Ailam mentioned key Iranian figures that might be targeted for elimination. The planned operation follows Israel's successful 2024 campaign against Hezbollah which involved explosive communication devices. Military operations against Iran may resume after the upcoming US midterm elections in November.

title: 'Why do you challenge democracy?' BJP says Rahul acting on behest of foreign powers
content: BJP leader Nitin Nabin accused Congress leader Rahul Gandhi of furthering foreign agendas at a rally in Haryana. Nabin criticized Congress for claiming democracy is at risk only when it loses elections in multiple states. He challenged allegations regarding voter deletion and past election irregularities linked to the party’s leadership. Nabin emphasized the need for governance based on the Constitution rather than dynastic politics.

title: Seifert, Phillips power New Zealand to win in the final T20I; India take series 3-2
content: Despite a seven-wicket defeat in the fifth T20I, India claimed the five-match series 3-2. Ishan Kishan and Shreyas Iyer contributed with hard-hitting half-centuries, while Tim Seifert and Glenn Phillips steered New Zealand to victory in the final match. Though New Zealand triumphed in this game, India's earlier wins secured their series success, showcasing the competition's intensity and skill on both sides.

title: 'Truly Evil, A Real-Life Bond Villain': An Ex-PM Describes Vladimir Putin
content: Stephen Harper acknowledged that Vladimir Putin is smart and hard-working, but he also accused him of being extremely manipulative and "truly evil".

content: EPF subscribers will be able to access their PF balance, latest five transactions and passbook information through EPFO's verified WhatsApp service, besides receiving personalised guidance and assistance in completing PMVBRY-related requirements.

content: Chief Justice Kant said that the top court has consistently respected the institutional autonomy of High Courts, but the frequency of such requests invites us to consider whether there is room to improve the responsiveness of our processes.

content: The accused, who was the victim's neighbour, had allegedly hit him on the head with a hammer and staged the scene to make it appear like a hit-and-run accident, police said.

title: 'Trump Won't Dictate Timing': Iran Says Any New US War Could Last Longer
content: "A potential future war could last longer than previous conflict, and the American president would not be in a position to dictate the timing or the conditions of its conclusion," said army spokesman Mohammad Akraminia.

content: Opposing the directive, helicopter operators have described the requirement as financially unviable and announced their proposal to suspend charter services until the matter is reviewed.
